prompt_text: Who is the best orthodontist in Phoenix for braces or Invisalign?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t a single objectively “best” orthodontist for everyone — the right doctor depends on your location, budget, age, treatment goals (traditional braces vs Invisalign), insurance, and personal preferences. I can help you find the best match in Phoenix — but first, some quick guidance and options for next steps.

What to look for
- Board certification/credentials: look for an orthodontist (DDS/DMD with a residency in orthodontics). American Board of Orthodontics (ABO) certification is a strong plus.  
- Invisalign experience: check how many Invisalign cases they’ve completed and whether they are a Platinum/Top provider (higher-volume providers tend to be more experienced with complex cases).  
- Before/after photos & patient reviews: these show real results and patient satisfaction.  
- Tech & comfort: do they use digital scanning (iTero), 3D planning, clear aligner expertise, accelerated options, etc.?  
- Communication & convenience: responsiveness, emergency care, office hours, payment/financing options, and location/parking.  
- Fit: some practices are more child/teen-oriented, others specialize in adult care or complex jaw problems.

How to find top local options
- Use the Invisalign “Find a Doctor” tool to locate Platinum/Top Invisalign providers in Phoenix.  
- Use the American Association of Orthodontists (AAO) “Find an Orthodontist” tool to confirm credentials.  
- Check Google, Yelp, and Healthgrades for patient reviews and before/after photos.  
- Ask friends/family or your general dentist for referrals.

If you want, I can:
- Look up highly rated orthodontists in Phoenix near your ZIP code and return a short list (with key details: Invisalign status, years of experience, average ratings).  
- Or give tailored suggestions if you tell me: your ZIP or neighborhood, whether the patient is an adult/teen/child, insurance or budget limits, and whether you prefer braces or Invisalign.

Which would you like me to do?
